title: Colossal Cave Adventure: graph zone text adventure (Tier 1)
description: The original Crowther & Woods (1977) text adventure. ~130 rooms as graph nodes, ~15 collectible objects as components, simple verb-object parser as game logic. Almost entirely data-driven: room connections are edges, object locations are component placements, puzzles are state flags (lamp lit, door open, snake scared). State transitions via CEL + perturbers — if player has item X in room Y, set flag Z. Seeded RNG for dwarf attacks and pirate. No WASM needed. Proves graph zone handles text adventures at Tier 1.
